After returning to my hometown for the first time in four and a half years, I learned a shocking truth at the high school I transferred to.
For some reason, I’m supposedly in a long-distance relationship with my childhood friend and now classmate, Kousaka Nanami, who has grown into a beautiful girl.
I have absolutely no memory of this, so what in the world is going on, Nanami?!
…Eh?
You got tired of being confessed to every day, so to keep the guys away, you made up a story about being in a long-distance relationship with me?
And you’re begging me to pretend to be your boyfriend?
I guess I have no choice, I’ll play the part of your boyfriend, but only while we’re at school──wait,
Do our parents believe in this long-distance relationship too?! There’s no turning back now…
All romantic rivals have already surrendered & both our families are giving us their ultimate blessing!
associated_names: Furaku no Bishoujo Doukyuusei to no Rabukome ga Iijii Moodo Sugiru Ken
不落の美少女同級生とのラブコメがイージーモード過ぎる件

123019.synopsis:
I am a female ghost.
Bored and idle, I secretly followed Jay, the first young master of the Immortal Sect, watching him slay demons and ghosts.
Half a year later, Jay suddenly spoke to me:
“Do you also want to dual cultivate with me?”
Me: ???
Jay: “You’ve been following me for so long, isn’t it because you’re interested in me?”
My ghostly face seemed to blush: “Nonsense!”
Under the cool moonlight, Jay laughed heartily and took a sip of wine.
His eyes shimmered, silently enticing:
“Dual cultivate with me, become the Ghost King, you won’t lose out.”
associated_names: 和最强剑主双修后，我成了女鬼王

127883.synopsis:
At the young age of nineteen, Jungwon became a father. He has since lived with grit and determination, raising his beloved son, Eunjo, all on his own. Eunjo—whom Jungwon wouldn’t trade for all the riches in the world—is the very source of his will to live.
But one day, Eunjo makes a dangerous new friend, a man called “Tiger Uncle”…
“Mister, you’re not a bad person to our Eunjo, right?”
Though they were only neighbors who seemed destined never to cross paths, the single father Jungwon and the so-called “Tiger Uncle,” Jungkwon, find themselves drawn together. Could the two of them, too, become good friends?

129675.synopsis:
After transmigrating, Xu Wanci found herself in the body of the notorious villainess from a popular cultivation novel.
The original character, obsessed with the male lead, repeatedly schemed against the female lead, committing countless atrocities.
In the end, the male lead, pushed to his limit, dragged her to the Hall of Justice, stripped her of her spiritual roots, and left her to die a miserable death.
Upon opening her eyes in this new world, Xu Wanci was met with the stern, imposing figure of the Hall’s elder.
At this life-or-death moment, her mind raced, and she dredged up a minor, barely-mentioned detail from the depths of the novel’s lore.
Lifting her head, she fixed the male lead with a hollow, desolate gaze and asked in a voice devoid of hope:
“There’s just one thing I want to know.”
“Is Chu Qingchuan truly the reincarnation of the Venerable Qingyan?”
Armed with her knowledge of the original story and pouring every ounce of her acting skills into the performance, she successfully convinced everyone that she was the beloved of the Venerable Qingyan.
A century ago, Qingyan had sacrificed himself to save the cultivation world from calamity, leaving every cultivator indebted to him.
And the key to ascension? Resolving one’s karmic debts.
Thus, not only did Xu Wanci save her own life, but she also became the linchpin for countless powerful figures seeking to ascend.
Watching these mighty cultivators fawn over her as their ticket to immortality, Xu Wanci played her part to perfection. To survive, she threw herself into cultivation while clinging fiercely to her carefully crafted persona as Qingyan’s devoted love:
Qingyan favored blue—so she draped herself in nothing but shades of azure.
Qingyan had a heart for saving the world—so she gave up treasures and devoted herself to aiding the needy.
Qingyan…
As she played the role, she also inherited countless relics Qingyan had left behind.
Just as she was basking in her success, she noticed something odd—every character from the original story seemed to be acting strangely.
The female lead went to great lengths just to make her smile.
The male lead desperately tried to prove he was Qingyan’s reincarnation.
Countless side characters treated her like an untouchable white moonlight.
And then there was the cultivation grandmaster who willingly became Qingyan’s substitute?
Xu Wanci: “…Did I overdo it?”
—
A hundred years ago, Xiao Yuyan sacrificed himself to mend the heavens.
Reborn as the new Heavenly Dao, he lost all memories of his past life—along with every trace of emotion.
He watched indifferently as the cultivation world forgot him, feeling not even a ripple of regret.
Observing everything Xu Wanci did in his name, he gazed at her with the detached pity reserved for all living beings:
No matter how much she sacrificed, no matter what history they might have shared, he would never remember.
But then—
When he saw Xu Wanci risking her life yet again for an offhand remark he’d once made, his tranquil heart stirred for the first time.
And so, the emotionless, desireless Heavenly Dao developed an obsession.
Staring at the so-called “Heaven’s Chosen” Chu Qingchuan, his eyes darkened:
“If the Heavenly Dao must favor someone… why shouldn’t it be her?”
P.S.: The female lead’s lies will never be exposed.
The male lead appears later in the story, around the mid-to-late arcs.
associated_names: 伪装成已逝仙尊的挚爱

141707.synopsis:
【Short version: Short-Ugly-Fat → Transformation → High School Heartthrob】
After being reborn into his high school years, Lu Yan awakens a Charm System.
Once short, ugly, and overweight, he begins a full-scale glow-up.
By the time he looks back, he’s become the guy every girl sees as untouchable—the walking embodiment of charm.
The one all his male classmates envy.
【Height Booster】【Facial Feature Enhancer】【Body Proportion Fix】【Aura of Presence】【Perfect Hands】…
With each mission completed, his looks and charm rise to new heights.
He moves effortlessly among the very girls who once seemed out of reach.
Nicknamed things like: Literary Prince, Piano Fairy Hands, Sports Prodigy, Most Alluring Male Vocalist…
Living life again, Lu Yan is determined to make it count—and shine like never before!
associated_names: 魅力升满：从高中开始成男神

159627.synopsis:
Most people experience some kind of trigger that leads to their ‘Transmigration’, except that I didn’t. I was just walking along the road, minding my own business, when I spaced out for a second and stumbled straight into this godforsaken void.
    It was dark, desolate, and lifeless. For tens of thousands of kilometres, there wasn’t a single living being, not even a blade of grass. 
    Me: Wow! Looks like I’ve fallen into the world of a manhua.
    In this alternate dimension, there is no concept of time. Aside from boredom, there is only more boredom. I counted the days on my fingers, so bored my brain was practically sprouting mushrooms.  I went from a vibrant, energetic young woman to some kind of undying monster of an unknown age.
    And then, one day, a bloodied young man appeared before me.
    Military uniform. A beauty. Beneath his messy black hair was a pair of emerald-green eyes, his injuries so severe that he looked as if he could drop dead any second.
    Normally, like any law-abiding, upstanding citizen of the Federation, I should have chosen to save a life. But I was so bored that I wanted to gouge my own eyes out for fun. So, I didn’t save him. Instead, I traced the lines of his eyes, praised his beauty, and then tricked him into sleeping with me.
    He looked fierce and utterly displeased, but who cares when you’re about to die anyway?
    But who would have thought that I’d be caught off guard and have my throat slit by a dagger hidden in his sleeve? As my blood sprayed, the young man flashed me a smile full of pure disgust.
    But here’s what happened: I didn’t die. 
    When I opened my eyes, everything had reverted to the day before.
    Although I didn’t understand why this happened, to be honest, it was great. After yesterday’s run, I was thoroughly satisfied and didn’t want to die anymore. 
    So, I went back and slept with him again, after which, unsurprisingly, I was killed again. Waking up again.
    It seems that in this space, my body is immortal and my time is infinite. Isn’t that just incredibly satisfying?
    As I collapsed into the young man’s arms to welcome my third death, I whispered, “Just you wait. I’ll be back for you tomorrow.”
    The Young Man: “?”
associated_names: 神经病和男美人当然最配啦[gb]

183179.synopsis:
It is best to avoid people who spread rumors.
Jiwoo, working as a TA, tries to avoid Ki Cheoljoo, a famous figure on campus.
“We decided to date starting yesterday, don’t you remember?”
“I’m telling you again, I have no intention of dating anyone.”
He easily crosses the line Jiwoo has barely managed to maintain.
“Have you ever taken a man down there?”
“…Don’t do something you’ll regret.”
“Shut up for a second. I’m thinking about how to undress you.”
They are fundamentally different from birth. Their living standards are different. Nothing about them matches.
Jiwoo doesn’t want to get close to someone so completely unlike him, so he tries to keep his distance.
But when he comes to his senses, his life, which didn’t seem like it would be dramatic, has already become a tangled mess of development and climax.
A distorted romance that begins with coercion and blackmail.
Jiwoo, growing increasingly exhausted by the abnormal relationship and nonsensical behavior, finally decides to run away.
“You’re always so full of certainty. What about now? Do you want to chase after me and tear me to shreds?”
– Sunbae, but…
From the other end of the silent phone, he heard the sound of the other person’s lips parting.
Like an old iron door barely opening after the passage of years, Ki Cheoljoo’s voice was desolate.
If you’re going to do it, you should do it properly.

183691.synopsis:
Xie Yan transmigrated overnight, becoming a cannon fodder character in the new work of a popular author notorious for starting stories and never finishing them. The catch? This was an Anomaly Resurgence novel!!! Without popularity points, he wouldn’t survive the day.
Xie Yan: Listen to me #$%
Forced by necessity, he transformed into a creepy male ghost. While the male lead was battling wits with an Anomaly in front of a mirror, Xie Yan crawled up from the ground, sporting the white hair and red eyes Costume bought with his Novice Points, and hugged the male lead from behind, fabricating on the spot that he was the male lead’s younger brother.
When you’re out in the world, your identity is what you make it. After all, in a world of Anomaly Resurgence, losing memories about a younger brother seemed perfectly fitting.
As for why he chose to be a younger brother—
Being young made it easier to play the sympathy card.
As for later roles—like the Experimental Subject Believer of the antagonist, or the Mysterious Swordsman who treated the Holy Son second male lead as a memento of a lost loved one… those were just side gigs.
…………
Shen Shi had lived for twenty years, facing the Anomaly Apocalypse with calm composure. That was until one day, while gambling with his life against an Anomaly in front of a mirror, the person he had just left half-dead crawled up from the ground, hugged him from behind, smeared blood all over his face from top to bottom, gently traced his brows and eyes, and said—
“Brother, I’ve finally found you.”

211595.synopsis:
After death, Luo Fan donated his organs.
He should have disappeared.
Instead, his consciousness awakened inside one thing that remained—
his own eyeball.
Trapped as a single living eye in the depths of an unknown abyss, Luo Fan discovers a terrifying ability: his cells can evolve without limit.
[Absorbed 1,000 joules of energy. Cell evolution successful.] 
[Intestinal evolution complete. Mineral conversion unlocked.] 
[Fused with dragon scales. Defensive structure enhanced.] 
[Spatial crystal absorbed. Void floating ability acquired.] 
From a powerless eyeball, he begins devouring, fusing, and evolving—organ by organ, creature by creature—until the horrors of the abyss become his nourishment.
Beasts, dragons, aberrations… all of them will become part of him.
And one day, the world looks up to find a colossal eye hanging above the void like a second sun.
Everything began with a single eyeball.
